Sections 5 and 7 are Nil, so no items. Section 11 and 12 statements (gifts and travel are received for companies, not personally) and the s14 'Matters of opinion as an Australian citizen' were treated as quasi-nil, so no items. Section 1/4 catch-all lines ('all other companies...') are recorded as single items. Resourcehouse Pty Ltd appears twice in s1 (as subsidiary and as a standalone entry) and both are recorded. Alteration page 19 (25 Feb 2014) has no section number; assigned to s3 with spouse as owner. The page 20 'approx value $3000' handwriting is appended to the three gift items. Signature page not legible on p19 and p20 beyond the dates. | pages 21-25: Pages 21-25 contain four separate alteration notifications lodged between February 2015 and February 2016.
